title: google-research/albert
summary: ALBERT (A Lite BERT) is a parameter-efficient variant of BERT developed by Google Research for self-supervised learning of language representations, using cross-layer parameter sharing and factorized embedding parameterization to significantly reduce model size while maintaining competitive performance on NLP benchmarks.
problem_solved: Reduces the massive parameter count of standard BERT models that cause memory and computational resource bottlenecks during training and deployment.
why_valuable: Enables researchers and practitioners to train and deploy BERT-like models with substantially reduced hardware requirements and faster training times while achieving comparable accuracy.
